summary: First MVP test of CRMEvent. Ran 29 pytest cases against backend covering auth, protected endpoints, dashboard, full CRUD for events/companies/persons/deals/staff/activities/followups, search, notifications, settings. All 29 passed. Frontend UI tested via Playwright: login with admin creds works, dashboard shows 21 KPIs, all 9 sidebar links navigate, seeded demo data visible (3 events, 8 companies, 10 persons, 8 deals across 6 pipeline columns, 5 staff, 3 activities, 4 followups). Created new event via UI dialog successfully. Global search returns evento+azienda matches. Notifications bell rendered.

issues: React a11y warning: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby. Add DialogDescription for accessibility (non-blocking).

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription to EntityDialog in /app/frontend/src/components/crm.jsx to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py handles both JWT and Google session_token cleanly via resolve_user_from_token. Solid.
seed_admin correctly updates existing admin password if it drifts from env (playbook-compliant).
Cookies set with httpOnly + secure + samesite=none: correct for cross-origin same-domain preview. Good.
PUT /api/settings accepts raw dict - consider Pydantic model for stricter validation but acceptable for MVP.
crud_routes: PUT uses exclude_unset=True and _update filters None values, allowing partial updates correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used server-side seed_demo data. Created TEST_UI_Event via UI (may remain in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend core flows verified. Note: Google OAuth (/api/auth/session) was not tested (requires real Google account per playbook). Kanban drag-drop wasn't tested but the fase-change dropdown on deal cards is present. Edit/delete-existing entity flows verified via delete button presence; the CRUD create/update/delete path was fully covered by backend tests. TEST_UI_Event may need cleanup in DB.
